content.thinking:
I've finished reading the document and am moving on to the structured output. There's an inconsistency in the shipping terms: it says EXW Boise, with DDP not agreed, yet also says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by the Seller and added to the invoice. Under EXW the buyer normally arranges freight, so I'll note this as a statement. I'm also starting on the line items, beginning with item 00010 for CMP-GAM-002 at a quantity of 9,000, and checking whether that quantity is confirmed.

I'm filling in the line values: quantity 9,000 as the confirmed quantity, unit price 6.11 USD, and the confirmed date 2026-06-12. The order reference 4500318660 is dated 2026-05-12, so I'll record that as the order date, and I'm leaving the total unstated since the document doesn't give one.

One line: item 00010, CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5, 9,000 pcs at 6.11 USD, confirmed for 2026-06-12. Terms are EXW Boise, payment NET30. The document has no corrections or handwriting.
red_flags: The delivery terms contradict each other. The document says EXW Boise and that DDP is not agreed. It also says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by the Seller and added to the invoice. Under EXW the buyer normally arranges and pays for freight. Check which party bears these costs and whether the extra charges are covered by the Sales Agreement PC-0011-2023 section 4.1.
The document gives no total line value and no unit of measure for the quantity.
The document has no issue date. Only the order date (2026-05-12) and the confirmed delivery date (2026-06-12) are shown.
observations: Clean printed single-page document with no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
The description wraps over three lines in the table (Game Card 64 / GB – Grand / Heist 5).
The quantity 9,000 uses a comma as the thousands separator (English convention).
